about: Line groups of the cell corpus, the unit held out whole (R-LEAD P1, reports/analisi/generalizzazione_contesti_2026-10-02/p1_r2). Every study, state, donor and clone of a line is one group; the iPSC group joins KOLF2.1J (derived from the HipSci donor kolf_2) and the HipSci donor lines, as the bench does; the neurons of Tian 2021 are a group of their own, as in the bench. A context of no rule is a group of its own (cell_data.group_of).
